SUB.name: skills-subtree-import
SUB.brief: Import agent-skills/skills via git subtree (NEVER a filesystem copy). First read docs/plans/skills-placement-decision.md: if Answer is still pending, write your DONE note as blocked and stop. Otherwise follow its procedure exactly (split -P skills in C:/Users/mauls/Documents/Code/agent-skills, subtree add under the confirmed prefix, full add then replace the 3 unlicensed dirs in a follow-up commit — do NOT delete them in this session). Move docs/unattended-orchestration.md into the unattended-orchestration skill and rewrite the 7 inbound links. Forbidden: secrets, binaries, touching qa-swarm/review-triage/babysit-prs content (RW lane owns them), merging into main yourself. Verify: python tests/check-links.py AND bash tests/run-tests.sh --filter link,docs AND powershell -File tests/run-tests.ps1 -Filter link,docs. Done means: tree present, links green, DONE note with commit hashes.

RW.name: skills-native-rewrites
RW.brief: Land the native rewrites for qa-swarm, review-triage, babysit-prs (unlicensed upstreams — never copy their text). First read docs/plans/rewrites/*.SKILL.md in your worktree: if absent, DONE-blocked and stop. Place them under the confirmed prefix from docs/plans/skills-placement-decision.md (same blocked rule as SUB). Then merge the instruction files: agent-skills AGENTS.md router/MCP/memory/scratch sections into AutoOS AGENTS.md as a new section of POINTERS (one home per fact, keep AutoOS hard rules canonical); Claude scope-trap into AutoOS CLAUDE.md; create AutoOS GEMINI.md from agent-skills GEMINI.md (repo-relative paths). Verify with a REAL skill-load check from opencode for every added skill (loading, not mere existence) plus the docs/link filters above. Report the opencode skill-dir finding in your DONE note. Forbidden: secrets, copying upstream sentences, merging into main yourself.
